meta.ratesNote: Rates, fees and public offers re-verified against official issuer pages and promotion terms on 2026-10-06. No drift since 2026-10-02: base earn rates, annual fees, 6/12-month issuer lookbacks, UOB One fixed quarterly awards, the AMEX 6-month 3% intro (capped at S$150 on S$5,000), OCBC's 1 October to 31 December 2026 welcome terms (OCBC 365: S$300 cashback on S$800 within 60 days; INFINITY: 14.4% bonus on the first S$2,000 within 60 days, capped at S$288) and UOB's 1 to 31 October 2026 UOB Absolute gift (Samsonite worth S$600, non-cash) are unchanged. Standard Chartered Simply Cash and UOB One have no card-only signup offer modeled. OCBC 365's revised cashback programme from 1 November 2026 (by posting date) is modeled as a dated rate schedule: a single S$800 minimum spend, S$160 monthly cap, 6% on dining (now including fast food), groceries, land transport and petrol, 3% at Watsons until 31 March 2027, and telco, utilities, streaming and EV charging at the 0.25% base rate. Estimates apply the terms in force on the calculation date to the whole horizon. OCBC 365 still advertises up to 1% on advertising-platform spend without minimum or cap; generic-spend rankings do not assume that category. Promo windows are date-checked at runtime — expired or known-ineligible signup value is not counted.
meta.disclaimer: Rates, promos, and fees change. Always verify on the issuer's official page before applying. This tool is educational, not financial advice.

cards.name: OCBC INFINITY Cashback

signup.notes: OCBC welcome promotion 1 October to 31 December 2026: new OCBC principal cardmembers with no current OCBC credit card and none in the prior 12 months earn a 14.4% bonus (16% total) on the first S$2,000 qualifying spend within 60 days of approval, bonus capped at S$288, no minimum spend. Modeled conservatively as S$288 once S$2,000 is spent inside 60 days; a partial bonus on smaller spend is not counted. Confirm live T&Cs.

cards.exclusionsNote: Standard bank exclusions may apply; verify qualifying spend definitions.
pros: Strong signup for large near-term spend
cons: Long-term rate slightly below UOB Absolute

cards.name: UOB Absolute Cashback

signup.notes: UOB Absolute promotion 1 to 31 October 2026 (apply and be approved in October): new-to-UOB principal cardmembers with no UOB principal card in the prior six months receive a Samsonite EVOA Z Spinner 25-inch Expandable (worth S$600) after at least S$1,000 eligible spend in each of the first 2 consecutive months. Non-cash and not used for ranking.

cards.exclusionsNote: Base model excludes the temporary 0.3% contactless bonus from 4 August 2026 through 31 January 2027. Selected local categories earn 0.3%; from 4 September 2026, selected overseas categories and Grab wallet top-ups also earn 0.3%. Confirm current terms.
pros: Highest simple flat rate among major banks (~1.7%)
Best long-term keeper for fuss-free users

cards.name: AMEX True Cashback

signup.notes: Intro 3% is the main acquisition value (capped at S$150 cashback on first S$5,000 eligible).

cards.exclusionsNote: Eligible purchases only; merchant acceptance lower than Visa/Mastercard.
pros: Strong intro boost if merchant takes Amex

cards.name: SC Simply Cash

signup.notes: The April 2025 to September 2026 new-to-SC card promotion (S$100 cashback plus Samsonite) ended on 30 September 2026. The October 2026 to February 2027 Spend and Save promotion pays NVIDIA shares only with a bundled Bonus$aver account, S$20,000+ fresh funds and an SC Online Trading account, so no card signup value is modeled.

cons: Weak reason to open if you already have SC

cards.name: UOB One

tieredRates.note: S$60 quarterly cashback requires at least S$600 eligible spend and 10 eligible purchases in each statement month for all three months of the qualifying quarter.
S$100 quarterly cashback requires at least S$1,000 eligible spend and 10 eligible purchases in each statement month for all three months of the qualifying quarter.
S$200 quarterly cashback requires at least S$2,000 eligible spend and 10 eligible purchases in each statement month for all three months of the qualifying quarter.

signup.notes: UOB's July to September 2026 acquisition promotion (S$100 Samsung e-voucher) ended on 30 September 2026, and UOB's official sign-up offers page lists no new UOB One welcome gift as of 2 October 2026. No signup value is modeled.

cards.exclusionsNote: Generic-spend estimates model only the fixed S$60/S$100/S$200 quarterly award. Not modeled: additional partner, grocery, and Singapore Power utilities cashback; category lists, caps, and tiers change frequently.

Single S$800 monthly minimum with a S$160 cap

Telco, utilities, streaming and EV charging earn the 0.25% base rate. The separate 1% marketing-expense rate (0.5% on advertising instalments) has no minimum spend and no cap; generic-spend rankings do not add it.
